text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate and latency observed for /v1/generate in us-west-2. Smart-routing fallback engaged; some requests routed to fallback variant 'gptx-lite-v2'. Seeing error spike and output corruption reports. Paging on-call.

jessica_oncall: ack — I'm on it. @ryan_sre you own smart-routing policies today, can you join?

ryan_sre: on my way. pulling logs. first glance shows canary rollout to 'gptx-experimental' started ~10m ago, health checks failing, but sticky fallback kept sessions bound to older variant that appears miscompiled.

samir_reliability: timeline pls — customers are seeing both latency and nonsense outputs? any high-impact customers?

jessica_oncall: support flagged two enterprise tenants with timeouts and hallucinated completions. @oliver_support adding details.

oliver_support: confirmed — Customer AcmeCorp reported responses with repeated tokens and wrong JSON structures since 12:17 PDT. Their SLA alerts fired. Collecting sample payloads.

ryan_sre: logs: many requests to 'gptx-lite-v2' hitting runtime error "kv-cache-mismatch" followed by 502. Also, policy engine shows fallback affinity TTL set to 1h for canary group -> sticky routing kept users pinned.

jessica_oncall: that suggests two interacting faults: canary failing + sticky fallback policy preventing normal routing. Can we open mitigation playbook?

jade_infra: status on pod restarts / OOM? I see increased GPU memory pressure on nodes hosting the canary variant; but errors are decoder-level rather than OOM.

ryan_sre: digging into variant metadata: canary model image tagged 'gptx-experimental:20260311' but tokenizer checksum differs from expected. It looks like model artifact registration accidentally pointed to a quantized build incompatible with current runtime.

samir_reliability: so wrong variant artifact + sticky fallback TTL = traffic pinned to a broken variant. Root cause combo confirmed.

maria_product: customer impact assessment: ~2% of global requests, concentrated in us-west-2 and affecting long-session chat flows. Some enterprise customers degraded. Need comms.

jessica_oncall: mitigation plan options: 1) disable sticky affinity for the rollout group (fast) 2) pause/rollback canary (requires deploy) 3) route affected customers to stable region/variant. I'm leaning 1 + 2. Thoughts?

ryan_sre: do 1) immediately, then 2). Disabling affinity will re-balance sessions away from broken variant. Command to run (console):

```
# disable sticky fallback for rollout 'canary-2026-03-11'
redwoodctl rollout update canary-2026-03-11 --sticky-affinity=false
```

ryan_sre: after that, start rollback job:

```
redwoodctl rollout rollback canary-2026-03-11 --to-version stable-20260228
```

jessica_oncall: executing step 1 now.

incident-bot: Action initiated by jessica_oncall: rollout update requested.

jessica_oncall: done — sticky-affinity flag false. Monitoring traffic shift.

ryan_sre: I see session redistribution starting. Error rate dropping in 60s window. Latency improving.

jade_infra: starting rollback pipeline now; ETA ~4 minutes to finish model swap on serving fleet.

samir_reliability: notify support + comms: suggest status update to affected customers with ETA and workaround.

oliver_support: crafting message: "We're rolling back a canary model which caused degraded responses. We expect full restoration within 15 minutes. No data loss. Contact support if you see persistent issues." Want to post to status page?

maria_product: yes, post brief note to status.redwood.ai and tag enterprise customers. Include mitigation steps and contact.

incident-bot: Rollback pipeline completed (job id: rb-1789). Canary removed from traffic.

ryan_sre: final check: 5xxs back to baseline, latency normalized, sample outputs look correct. Confirming sticky sessions cleared.

jessica_oncall: switching incident state -> monitoring. Assigning follow-up: improve validation for model artifact registration and add pre-rollout tokenizer checksum verification.

samir_reliability: add policy change: reduce default fallback affinity TTL for canaries to 5m unless explicitly extended. That would prevent long-lived pinning to broken fallback.

ajde_infra: (typo: jade_infra) noted. I'll file infra ticket for checksum gate and update rollout defaults.

maria_product: need post-incident notes and customer RCA. Who will own comms and RCA?

jessica_oncall: I'll lead RCA, @ryan_sre + @jade_infra + @oliver_support to contribute. Target doc by EOD tomorrow.

oliver_support: sent customer updates and opened priority support threads with affected customers.

ryan_sre: temp mitigation validated. Closing pager. Please react when you see all clear. :thumbsup:

jessica_oncall: closing pager. Good job team. :party-parrot:
